fact: The World Bank's implementation status report archived on 17 April 2024 states that registration of primary school learners in NEMIS is about 60 per cent, against above 98 per cent for secondary school learners, so that some primary schools are not receiving their full capitation grants; the figure is a share of learners, not of schools, and no counts are given.
title: Implementation Status & Results Report: Primary Education Equity in Learning Program (P176867), Seq No: 5
